# Welcome

These are the working notes for **CBE 20260 Introduction to Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics** (Spring 2026).

Use the **Lectures** menu in the navigation bar to jump to individual lecture notes.

The **Notebooks** tab contains Jupyter notebooks that accompany the class materials.

The site will be updated periodically throughout the semester. You can download a pdf of the notes by clicking on the link in the upper right corner of the page.

> These materials are meant to accompany the textbook  
> *Fundamentals of Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics* by Dahm and Visco.

See the course Canvas site for the syllabus, schedule, and other materials. 

If you find errors in the notes, please let me know via email: <ed@nd.edu>
